propositions: Backfill complexity and clone-count series by checking out sampled historical commits (default monthly cadence) and writing snapshots through the going-forward snapshot writer.
Per-commit measurement is isolated in measure_tree(tree_path) returning complexity and clone_count integers, monkeypatched in tests so no external tools are required.
complexity is the summed cyclomatic complexity from lizard and clone_count is statistics.total.clones from a jscpd JSON report.
Each snapshot's ts must equal the sampled commit's date (git committer date), not the backfill run's wall-clock time, so trends have meaningful history.
A commit whose measure_tree returns None (tool absent or errors) is skipped and logged without aborting the backfill.
Every written snapshot is labeled source=snapshot and confidence=high.
